en.title: Brush Your Teeth Song with Momo the Bunny | Morning Routine for Toddlers
en.description:
Brush, brush, up and down! Join Momo the Bunny and Ducky for a happy morning tooth-brushing routine. A gentle say-along chant for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2-5).

What we learn today:
1. A toothbrush and just a tiny dot of toothpaste
2. Brush up and down - top teeth and bottom teeth
3. Sip, swish and rinse with a cup of water

Say it with Momo and brush together every morning and every night!

#BrushYourTeeth #ToddlerLearning #KidsSongs #NurseryRhymes #MorningRoutine #PreschoolLearning #HealthyHabits #MomoTheBunny #BabySongs #LearnWithMomo

narration.en: Good morning, friends! The sun is up. Yawn! Time to start the day!
Hmm... my teeth feel fuzzy and sticky. What should we do, friends?
It's morning! Let's brush our teeth together! Brush, brush, brush!
Look! This is a toothbrush. A little toothbrush. Toothbrush!
Momo holds the toothbrush. My very own toothbrush! Hello, toothbrush!
Now a little toothpaste. Not too much. Just a tiny dot!
Can you say toothpaste? [pause 1.5] Toothpaste! Yay, great job!
Squeeze, squeeze, just a little bit of toothpaste. Perfect!
[chant] Brush up, brush down, brush your teeth all around! Brush up, brush down!
Brush the top teeth. Up, up, up! Gently up, up, up!
Brush the bottom teeth. Down, down, down! Gently down, down, down!
Up and down, up and down. Can you do it too? [pause 1.5] Yes!
You did it! Great brushing, friends!
Quack, quack! Here comes Ducky with a little cup of water!
Water in the cup helps us rinse. Rinse, rinse, rinse!
Sip a little water. Swish, swish, swish! Funny puffy cheeks!
And spit it out! Ptooey! All clean and fresh!
Ducky asks: can you say rinse? [pause 1.5] Rinse! Hooray!
Let's remember! Toothbrush, toothpaste, and a cup of water!
[chant] Brush up, brush down, swish and spit, all around! Swish and spit!
Show me your smile! Big, sparkly smile! Sparkly clean teeth!
Brush every morning and every night. Keep a big, bright smile!
